name: What should I consider before replacing a skylight to improve energy efficiency?
description: Focus on Low-E coatings, argon gas fills, and good U-factor/SHGC ratings for energy efficiency, ensuring proper installation.

mainEntity.name: What should I consider before replacing a skylight to improve energy efficiency?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before replacing a skylight for energy efficiency, consider units with low-emissivity (Low-E) coatings and argon gas fills, which help reduce heat transfer. Also, look for U-factor and Solar Heat Gain Coefficient (SHGC) ratings; lower values indicate better energy performance. Your local climate in the Alameda area will influence the optimal SHGC. Proper installation with airtight seals is crucial to maximize energy savings. Upgrading to an ENERGY STAR certified skylight is a good benchmark.
acceptedAnswer.description: Focus on Low-E coatings, argon gas fills, and good U-factor/SHGC ratings for energy efficiency, ensuring proper installation.
